avoid_list.detail: Oct-2026 tightening CONFIRMED multi-source (Digital Trends, ppc.land, Storyboard18, NeoTeo): from Oct 1, 2026, Shorts recommendations prioritize original content and cut reach for re-uploads without meaningful additions; clipping payments KSh 130-520 per 1K views (Kenyan Mirror, Oct 5, 2026); reposted clips with little commentary are flagged unoriginal and FYP-ineligible on TikTok. From Feb 1, 2027, Shorts revenue sharing needs 10M qualified Shorts views per 90 days (multi-source) - a second cliff for repost-heavy Shorts channels.
avoid_list.name: Clipping / repost channels

avoid_list.detail: YouTube's January 2026 inauthentic-content enforcement removed 16 major channels (4.7B combined views) and demonetized thousands of low-effort AI channels (UTubeKit, Jul 2026). Risky faceless formats: AI personas giving money or health advice (unmonetizable), article readings, clip compilations, templated top-5 lists (Synthesys, Oct 2026). Faceless still works — but only with visible human creativity.
avoid_list.name: Low-effort AI slop

avoid_list.detail: Fastest channel growth measured (1.59%/mo) but the worst pay: $0.33 RPM — about 3M views to earn $1,000 (AIR Media-Tech). Growth is not revenue. Made-for-kids content also faces strict ad rules. 2027 update: Shorts-heavy kids channels also face the Feb-2027 10M-views/90d Shorts revenue floor (multi-source).
avoid_list.name: The kids-content trap

avoid_list.detail: Documented removal risk on TikTok (buyTikTokAccount, Aug 2026).
avoid_list.name: Gambling / crypto on TikTok

avoid_list.detail: Flagged and FYP-ineligible (buyTikTokAccount, Aug 2026). Health education is fine; claims and diagnoses are not.
avoid_list.name: Medical-advice claims on TikTok
Shorts-only channels chasing pool revenue (post-Feb-2027)
avoid_list.detail: From Feb 1, 2027, Shorts ad + subscription revenue sharing requires 10M qualified Shorts views per 90 days, checked monthly - below it the Shorts pool pays nothing that month (announced Aug 10, 2026; multi-source: AIR, AuditSocials, Tablet News, GSMDome). Shorts RPMs were already 3-14% of long-form (AIR, 274 channels). A Shorts-only channel with no long-form catalog is building on the thinnest revenue layer there is.

growth_context: Channel-growth figures below are median monthly subscriber growth among 10K-100K-subscriber YouTube channels in the AIR Media-Tech / TubeAI study (Sep 7-27, 2026). The all-channel median was 0.97%/mo. Medians hide huge variance — they describe the middle of a cohort, not your outcome.

caveats: Channel growth 1.44%/mo is the AI & ML cohort median (TubeAI, Sep 2026).
Competition rising fast — speed and specificity beat breadth here.

outlook_2027.summary: Directional reads for 2027, not predictions: which niches the current signals point up, hold flat, or down - and why. Every trajectory carries its basis and sources; medians describe cohorts, never your outcome.

platform_signals.signal: YouTube's 2027 priorities: Shopping, micro-dramas, custom content feeds
platform_signals.detail: Lia Haberman's read of Made On YouTube 2026: platform resources going to shoppable video, serialized micro-dramas (Shorts Series), and interest-curated custom feeds.

platform_signals.signal: Microdrama boom: 6.5B YouTube views in H1 2026; ~$14B industry 2026 estimate
platform_signals.detail: Industry revenue estimate is single-source (FastCompany, Sep 2026); the platform commitment (Shorts Series, Made On YouTube) is multi-source.

platform_signals.signal: YPP 2027: Shorts revenue sharing needs 10M qualified Shorts views per 90 days from Feb 1, 2027
platform_signals.detail: Announced Aug 10, 2026; multi-source (AIR Media-Tech, AuditSocials, Tablet News, GSMDome). New applicants: 8,000 watch hours or 20M Shorts views. Existing YPP long-form monetization unaffected; below the floor the Shorts pool pays nothing that month.
Signals more sponsored-content budgets flowing through TikTok's own pipelines - favors niches brands already buy (beauty, food, lifestyle, finance).
YouTube custom feeds, TikTok FYP, LinkedIn dueling feeds: distribution organizes around interests, not follower counts. Niching down matters more, not less.
Confirmed multi-source (Digital Trends, ppc.land, Storyboard18, NeoTeo): Shorts recommendations prioritize original content and reduce reach for re-uploads without meaningful additions.

outlook_2027.evidence_note: Trajectories are the site's directional read of October-2026 signals - not forecasts. 'Heating' means multiple current signals point up; 'stable' means steady demand and steady risk; 'cooling' means the measured risks (competition, rate pressure, policy) outweigh the growth signals. Re-check before acting.
